package main

// Excerpt of openweft/weft-loom-server v0.4.0 (cmd/weft-loom/main.go:138 and
// internal/server/prespawn.go:159): an env value written straight into a
// struct field. The names say PASS and ACCESS_KEY, which the first vocabulary
// did not know.

import (
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

type smtpCfg struct{ Password string }
type cubefs struct{ AccessKey string }

func main() {
	_ = smtpCfg{
		Password: os.Getenv("WEFT_LOOM_SMTP_PASS"),
	}
	_ = cubefs{AccessKey: os.Getenv("WEFT_CUBEFS_ACCESS_KEY")}
	_ = http.ListenAndServe(":8080", nil)
}
